dx.description: Movement this tick in 1/256 pixel units, before the simulation's speed cap (ADR-038).

fire.description: The main shot fires only on ticks with `fire` (ADR-038).

held.description:
The skill slot held this tick: 0 for none, 1 to 3 (ADR-032). Press, hold and release
are read from how this changes between ticks.
